mapper.insert: insert into manufacturer (manufacturer_code, manufacturer_name, contact_person, phone, email, address) values (#{manufacturerCode}, #{manufacturerName}, #{contactPerson}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address})
mapper.update: update manufacturer set manufacturer_code = #{manufacturerCode}, manufacturer_name = #{manufacturerName}, contact_person = #{contactPerson}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, address = #{address} where manufacturer_id = #{manufacturerId}
